title: Take-home packet: staggered cohort schedule & reviewer sign-up

Take-home packet: staggered cohort schedule & reviewer sign-up

['From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>\\nTo: Zoe Martinez <zoe.martinez@gmail.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2027-04-05T09:12:00Z\\nSubject: Take-home packet: staggered cohort schedule & reviewer sign-up\\n\\nHi Zoe —\\n\\nThanks again for your time on the interview earlier. Attached is the take-home prompt (takehome_prompt_v3.pdf) and the evaluation rubric we’ll use. To make scheduling fair across time zones and reviewer load we’re running two staggered cohorts:\\n\\n- Cohort A (standard): submit by Tue, April 12 23:59 PT — target for most candidates.\\n- Cohort B (extended): submit by Fri, April 16 23:59 PT — for candidates who request extra time or need weekend buffer.\\n\\nPlease reply to confirm which cohort you’d like to join. Submission instructions are in the prompt (PDF) — we prefer a single ZIP with a README and any notebooks (label your files like lastname_firstname_*). You can upload to the Google Drive link below or reply with the ZIP attached.\\n\\nReviewers: We’ll assign two reviewers (one engineering, one product) and aim to provide feedback within 5 business days of the submission deadline for your cohort. I’ll take Cohort A (April 12). A quick question: is the code-run environment required to be Linux-based, or is a Mac-locally runnable submission acceptable? I want to make sure I include a short runbook.\\n\\nI’ll upload the ZIP to the Drive by the deadline.\\n\\nThanks,\\nZoe\\n\\nOn Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 09:12 Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:\\n> Hi Zoe —\\n> \\n> Thanks again for your time on the interview earlier. Monday morning block works. If Marcus needs to swap, I can shift to Wednesday morning instead.\\n\\nQuick note on scoring: if we see an implementation shortcut, please call it out in comments and mark rubric "partial" where appropriate — I’ll annotate with suggested follow-ups for interviews.\\n\\nThanks,\\nJonas\\nJonas Weber\\nStaff Software Engineer\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\nOn Apr 5, 2027, at 14:30, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:\\n> Team —\\n> \\n> Zoe confirmed Cohort A...\\n>', 'From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>\\nTo: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2027-04-06T09:22:00Z\\nSubject: Re: Take-home packet: staggered cohort schedule & reviewer sign-up\\n\\nThanks — I can take the product reviewer slot. We’ll target written feedback by April 16 EOD (short comments + rubric scores).\\n- Submission: upload to the Drive link or reply here with the ZIP. If you hit any blocker, let us know and we can discuss a one-off extension.\\n\\nGood luck — we’re looking forward to seeing it.\\n\\nBest,\\nHannah\\n\\nOn Apr 5, 2027, at 11:03, Zoe Martinez <zoe.martinez@gmail.com> wrote:\\n> Hi Hannah —\\n> \\n> Thanks for sending this over.
